title: UI Alignment & Human-Centric Design System
summary: Enforced a strict design system: global Container strategy, semantic spacing tokens, mobile safe-area utilities, 44x44dp touch targets, CSS-grid discovery feed, strict vendor KDS grid, and typography normalization.

tasks.name: Strict Spacing & Layout Tokens
tasks.details: packages/config/tailwind.config.ts now defines a semantic spacing scale (space-2xs..space-2xl) and dropped the unused arbitrary 18/88/128 values. New packages/ui Container component owns max-width (max-w-5xl default, 2xl/3xl/7xl/full variants), centering (mx-auto w-full) and gutter (px-4 sm:px-6). Consumer root layout and vendor non-dashboard layout wrap children in Container; pages dropped their own max-w/px gutters (no double padding).

tasks.name: Mobile Safe Areas & Thumb-Zone Optimization
tasks.details: pt-safe/pb-safe/pl-safe/pr-safe + min-h-touch/min-w-touch utilities in both globals.css. BottomNav: min-h-16 + pb-safe so tabs clear the home indicator; tabs are min-h-11 (44px). Button md/lg enforce min-h-[44px]. CartDrawer CTAs/steppers, KDS advance/hand-over/OTP, checkout/profile primary CTAs, settlements/catering CTAs all hit 44x44dp.

tasks.name: Visual Hierarchy & Alignment (Consumer)
tasks.details: Discovery feed uses strict CSS Grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4. Typography normalized to token scale (removed all text-[10px]/text-[11px] arbitrary sizes). CartDrawer slides up with a translate-y transition, consistent p-space-sm content padding, pb-safe clearance, 44px quantity steppers + CTAs.

tasks.name: Vendor KDS Alignment
tasks.details: KDS stage container is now a strict responsive CSS Grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-3 p-4 (replacing fixed flex min-w-[960px] horizontal scroll). Tickets use flex flex-col justify-between with flex-1 item list so Timer/Items/Action align and action buttons pin to the bottom. Advance/Hand Over buttons and OTP input are min-h-[44px].
